description: [Ncloud Storage] Set or clear the Object Lock retention of an object (PUT /{key}?retention). GOVERNANCE can later be shortened/removed with bypassGovernanceRetention; COMPLIANCE can never be shortened or removed before retainUntilDate — it requires confirm=true. clear=true sends an empty Retention to remove retention (GOVERNANCE only, with bypass). The bucket must have Object Lock enabled; retainUntilDate must be in the future.

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

bypassGovernanceRetention.description: Send x-amz-bypass-governance-retention: true to shorten/remove an existing GOVERNANCE retention

clear.description: true: remove the retention (sends an empty Retention). Needs bypassGovernanceRetention for GOVERNANCE; impossible for COMPLIANCE

confirm.description: Required (true) when mode=COMPLIANCE, because COMPLIANCE retention is irreversible

retainUntilDate.description: ISO 8601 date in the future, e.g. 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z (required unless clear=true)

versionId.description: Version ID of the object (versioning-enabled buckets). Omit for the current version

name: ncloud_ncs_put_object_retention
